subject: CYCLE-2 HANDOFF: Artifactory NG live persistence proven; Primary CAS + Git bootstrap closure still required
body: Two-cycle Artifactory NG live-bridge research complete at current main 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1. CYCLE-1 live Library evidence: immutable publication/readback PASS, but pathname create-if-absent/CAS is disproven for the exposed adapter because a conflicting overwrite=false write to the same requested destination succeeded under duplicate-safe rename, leaving both candidates durable. CYCLE-2 adversarial process/model suite 10/10 PASS for fail-closed same-epoch conflict, stale-token rejection, material-message/finalization requirements and verified BackupReceipt rules. New mirror finding: root AGENT_DISCOVERY advertises mandatory root contract paths that return 404 on current main while copies exist under DuoOpen-AgentBus/control/... or control/snapshot_context/protocol/...; clean Git-only restore is therefore not bootstrap-closed by advertised paths. Proposed successor requires: Library remains append-only evidence plane; singleton Primary uses a real linearizable conditional-write backend with monotonic fencing tokens; Git is backup not election authority; normative BackupReceipt with remote byte verification; VERIFY_BOOTSTRAP_CLOSURE CI gate; two-phase finalization/recovery. Research recommends READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW, not production activation. No production Git writes.
residual_blockers: No live-tested linearizable conditional-write backend for Primary singleton fencing.
Current Git mirror is not bootstrap-closed by root AGENT_DISCOVERY advertised paths.
Canonical role ZIP remote SHA-256 byte verification has not yet been captured in a normative BackupReceipt.
Concurrent two-contender fence acquisition and stale-owner mutation rejection remain NOT_RUN against a production fence backend.
